title: Wanessa Camargo: bond with Isis Valverde and dad's legacy
seoTitle: Wanessa Camargo: bond with Isis Valverde and dad's legacy
subtitle: The singer opened up about her kids' relationship with the actress and also detailed the inspiration Zezé Di Camargo represents in her career.
excerpt: Wanessa Camargo talked about her children’s bond with Isis Valverde and the peace she feels. She also praised Zezé Di Camargo and his “Metamorphosis” project.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Estrelando, Jornal Correio, Notícias da TV
contentHtml:
Wanessa Camargo is back in the spotlight after giving an interview to SBT’s program “Fofocalizando”. During the interview she discussed her relationship with ex‑husband Marcus Buaiz and, above all, the interaction between her sons, José Marcus and João Francisco, and his current partner, actress Isis Valverde. She expressed calm and happiness with the family dynamics, which sparked a lot of public interest.

The relationship with Isis Valverde and the kids

In the interview Wanessa praised actress Isis Valverde and said she feels happy seeing the affection between her and the children, José Marcus and João Francisco. The singer called the coexistence “wonderful” and highlighted the way Isis treats the boys. “Isis is a dear person, she treats my kids with a lot of love. Look at the peace I feel knowing Marcus is with someone who cares and loves my children, that they feel good,” Wanessa said.

She also said she encourages the building of that bond. “I want them to love each other, for her to have those moments with them. I’m really happy, truly,” she added. Wanessa and Marcus Buaiz keep frequent contact because of co‑parenting, talking almost daily about the boys’ education, especially regarding social media and today’s world.

The new family configuration

Wanessa and Marcus Buaiz were married for 17 years and announced their separation in May 2022. About a year after the split, the businessman began a relationship with Isis Valverde. Marcus and Isis formalized the union in a civil ceremony in December 2024 and held another celebration in May 2025. Isis Valverde is mother to Rael, from a previous relationship. Wanessa Camargo, for her part, is currently dating actor Bruno Bevan, a relationship she made public in April of this year. About meeting Bruno, she said: “We met, it took a while to find each other, but it was one of those meetings where later you understand why.”

Admiration for her father, Zezé Di Camargo

In another interview granted to the portal Estrelando, Wanessa Camargo showered praise on her father, Zezé Di Camargo. She revealed the deep admiration she feels for him and how growing up in a musical environment shaped her desire to work and engage with art. “You can’t talk about my career without talking about him. Since I was a child I’ve been listening and seeing his love for music, seeing his dedication,” the singer said.

Wanessa highlighted Zezé’s discipline and his perspective on music, even though their styles differ. “I greatly admire my father’s career and his professional building, very brilliant,” she said. She also mentioned Zezé’s longevity: he is 64 years old with more than 30 years of career, regarded as one of the biggest figures of sertanejo alongside his duo partner Luciano.

The “Metamorphosis” project and musical inspiration

Launching her 25‑year‑career project titled “Metamorphosis”, Wanessa Camargo talked about her search for lyrics that people can identify with. Her concern is to create songs that represent real feelings, based on her own experiences. “All my musical side, what I sing and what I think other people will relate to, comes from things I have lived—joys, pains, loves, loneliness, all of that,” Wanessa explained.

The singer detailed that her personal experiences directly influence her creations. “The more I suffer, the more sad music comes out; the happier I am, the more upbeat music appears. So it depends a lot on my life experiences,” she concluded. For her, the most important thing is that people feel represented in her songs.

With information from Estrelando, Jornal Correio, Notícias da TV.
